title: Spec v2: what the inspector sees

blocks.text: Was: nightly batch, Balcony to Mesh Routing.
Now: events, through a local queue on the device.
When the connection comes back, the queue drains on its own, oldest first.
Balcony keeps working when Mesh Routing is down or the tablet is offline. Nobody waits on the network to finish an inspection.
From Tuesday's design review with Mercutio and Romeo.
Three states per inspection: queued, sent, needs attention.
Queued: saved on the device, waiting for a connection. Safe, not a guess.
Sent: delivered. A check and the time.
Needs attention: a person has to do something, like a sync conflict or a photo that failed. Says which inspection and what to tap.
Show how many inspections are queued, and let the number go down as they send.
Never a spinner on this screen.
